title: Chapter 300
text:
Li Ge was very high profile, and he created a new hot topic. Some players even started betting on who would win between Li Ge and Hao Tian.

Although Li Ge had made it to the top 16, he had used his abilities to slowly grind his opponents to death. There was nothing interesting about it, so Li Ge's odds were even higher.

Mad Blade's opponent was Rainy Kim, who was also a strong opponent. Rainy Kim was the pillar of Team Storm. She was very strong, and she was also a beautiful woman.

Beautiful women were usually treated well, especially in the professional scene where there was a huge imbalance between men and women. Rainy Kim's popularity was off the charts. After the group list was announced, Rainy Kim's fans went to the Rivervale Club's page and threatened Frenzied Sword that if he won, they would make him pay for it.

Han Xiao waited for seven or eight days at the top of the mountain. After the first round, he was surprised to see that Hao Tian actually lost to Li Ge in a one-on-one battle. He only won the first round, and Li Ge defeated him in all three rounds.

Watching the recording, Hao Tian's performance in the first round was still stable. Li Ge played around for ten minutes before he finished. He was analyzing Hao Tian's fighting style. Starting from the second round, Li Ge gained the upper hand. He could almost see through Hao Tian's movements. His ability was perfect for a long battle. Hao Tian was like a bug trapped in a spider's web, and he lost all three rounds.

Li Ge was a very talented professional player. His career was not very long, but he had achieved a lot. Han Xiao had once considered whether to add Li Ge to the list of candidates.

The media changed their opinion again. Li Ge suddenly became a new force, and he took away Hao Tian's original attention. This time, it was Li Ge's turn to be favored by the media. He made it to the top eight, and his next opponent was Mad Blade, who had barely defeated Rainy Kim to advance to the next round.

Mad Blade had barely defeated Rainy Kim and made it into the top eight. It should have been a happy occasion, but Rainy Kim's hardcore fans were furious. His fans were hundreds of times more than Rainy Kim's, and their voices of support were drowned out by the waves of scolding. In the end, Rainy Kim begged them to stop. These people were still angry, as if they had been wronged.

Rainy Kim had lost fair and square, but some things were unreasonable. She could not blame her fans, so she could only apologize to Mad Blade in private. They had known each other during the closed beta, so they could be considered half acquaintances.

Mad Blade felt very wronged. He had won fair and square, but he had gained a bunch of haters.

However, in the end, the results spoke louder than words. The normal audience members accepted his victory, and some of the neutral audience members became Mad Blade's fans. Mad Blade gained a wave of fans through this strange situation, and many people started to hate Rainy Kim … but in reality, she was also unjustly implicated.

There was a lot of trouble when one was popular, and it was hard to say who would benefit more. However, if Han Xiao were to say, most of the audience members just wanted to find someone to entertain themselves with. They wanted to participate in a storm and fight for a certain side.

When they found out that Mad Blade's next opponent was Li Ge, many haters rejoiced in his misfortune.

"Serves him right!"

"Haha, this b * stard is going to stop here."

"Big Boss Li Ge will definitely crush him."

Frenzied Sword did not even have a fifty percent chance of winning against Hao Tian in a private duel. Now that he was up against Li Ge, who could definitely beat Hao Tian, his future was not looking good. Han Xiao pondered to himself. Could it be that the two players he had high hopes for were going to be defeated by Li Ge alone?

…

"Sir, the satellite radar has detected a strange object rapidly approaching the atmosphere!"

In the Northern Continent, the alarm at the Raylan observatory rang. The observers jumped up from their seats and looked at the big screen in shock.

The satellite radar showed that a light dot was coming from outer space and was rapidly approaching the Blue Star.

"Is that a meteorite?"

"The target suddenly appeared three minutes ago and was just captured by the radar. If it was a meteorite, it wouldn't have been discovered so soon. Plus, meteorites can't be captured so quickly by the magnetic field of the planet!"

"Could it be an alien spaceship?"

"It's getting faster and faster. It's estimated to hit the surface in eight minutes!"

"Where is it? Is it an uninhabited area? "

"It's estimated to land in a desolate mountain range in the Northern Continent. The coordinates are … near the border of our country!"

The person in charge of the observatory, the doctor, said in a low voice, "Report it immediately and request for reinforcements!"

…

Huang Jian fiddled with the dashboard out of boredom. He had waited in this godforsaken place for almost ten days, and nothing had happened. With his boss's legendary status, he did not think that Han Xiao would come here for no reason. He was very curious about what Han Xiao was waiting for.

In the snow, Han Xiao suddenly looked up. He then turned around and boarded the helicopter. He pulled out the equipment box.

Finally, there's movement! Huang Jian was excited. He turned around and asked curiously, "What are you doing?"

"It's coming." Han Xiao did not look up. He quickly put on the equipment.

"What's coming?" Huang Jian was confused.

As soon as he asked, an ear-piercing shriek came from the sky. Huang Jian looked up and saw a burning meteor falling from the sky. The outline of a spaceship could be seen in the dancing flames.

Boom!

The falling spaceship crashed into a steep mountain peak. The shattered black rocks and white snow were like exploding fireworks. The spaceship rolled and plowed a several-hundred-meter-long earth dragon in the snowy mountain range. The trees along the way were set ablaze, and black smoke billowed out. The earth trembled because of it!

The snow on the mountain peak collapsed, forming a small avalanche. It was hard not to notice such a big commotion. As expected, Han Xiao was right. When it arrived, he would definitely know.

Huang Jian's mouth was wide open. He was dumbfounded.

"F-F-Spaceship!"

Huang Jian looked at Han Xiao in disbelief. He had heard of Han Xiao's achievements, but seeing it for himself was better than hearing about it a hundred times! He even knew that an alien spaceship was going to crash!

Soon, Han Xiao finished changing. He put on the Amphiptere mechanical suit and moved his limbs. He took out the mechanical wing-like batwing aircraft from the equipment box and installed it on the back of the suit.

The tactical screen showed the status of the aircraft. It was operating normally.

"Fly!" Han Xiao thought and ran toward the cliff. The aircraft hummed, and the triple-stack propellers on the wings spun at the highest speed. Blue flames shot out from the tail.

Whoosh!

Han Xiao felt the force pulling him up into the air, and his entire body rose into the air.

He used the nerve connection to control the aircraft effortlessly. He quickly flew toward the crash site.

…

The Observer spaceship was stuck into the ground sideways, covering half of its body. The trees and soil around it were burning, but the exterior of the spaceship was basically undamaged. The energy shield protected the spaceship from disintegrating during the crash, but the impact of the landing had depleted the energy of the shield, and the engine was destroyed.

Bang!

The cabin door was pushed open. Kerlodd held his head in pain and staggered out, muttering in Godora.

Kerlodd pressed on the golden bracelet on his right hand a few times. With the bracelet as the center, a battle suit that looked like ancient armor automatically appeared and covered his body. There was no helmet, but a translucent energy shield protected his face.

This was the Godora investigator battle suit. The investigator had to travel to different planets. The battle suit had life-support systems and environmental analysis functions. A synthetic mechanical voice sounded.

"Database matched. Location: Star Zone 9, Blue Star.

Gravity level: Low

Current temperature: 3 degrees

Climate type …

Air composition …

Civilization level: Surface civilization

Danger level: Low

Evaluation: Survivable

Kerlodd was a little dizzy. "Check my body condition."

"Analyzing … analysis complete. Three fractures detected, many soft tissue damage, mild concussion. Do you want to inject nano-repair fluid?"

"Inject."

Kerlodd felt a cooling sensation on the back of his neck, and he felt much better. He immediately crawled back to the control room of the spaceship. He wanted to activate the mainframe to check the cause of the malfunction, but it showed that all the systems were damaged.

Kerlodd had no choice but to open the exterior armor of the spaceship and expose the internal structure. He tore open a bunch of pipes and pulled out a palm-sized metal box. The indicator light flashed blue, indicating that everything was normal. This was the intergalactic communicator.

Of course, Kerlodd's intergalactic communicator was not the same as the one from the Six Nations. According to the investigator rules, he needed to do two things. One was to use the communicator to contact the headquarters, and the other was to ask for help from a friendly local civilization, which was to contact the Six Nations.

At this moment, a vibration sound came from the sky. Han Xiao, who was wearing a black mechanical suit with two giant mechanical wings, landed beside the spaceship.

"It is indeed similar to what I saw in the prophecy. Oh, there is a living person here."

Han Xiao saw the Godora person beside him. He was very knowledgeable, so he recognized that this was the investigator's equipment. He raised his eyebrows slightly and locked his eyes on the intergalactic communicator in Kerlodd's hand.

This was what he wanted!

"A native of the Blue Star?" Kerlodd sized him up and switched to the translator mode. The Godora language was changed into a language that Han Xiao could understand. He pointed at Han Xiao and said calmly,
